PAYMENTS AND GST INVOICES
Razorpay: create an account, copy Key Id + Key Secret, add an HTTP Basic Auth credential (user = Key Id, password = Key Secret) to 'Razorpay: create order', and set razorpay_key_id, razorpay_key_secret in each Config node (configure.js does it). Add a Razorpay webhook to /webhook/vaigai-razorpay-webhook for payment.captured with razorpay_webhook_secret.
GST: confirm HSN codes and rates with your CA in InvoiceEngine (Code nodes 'Build Invoice' and 'Find Invoice'), and set your GSTIN, FSSAI number and address. Invoice numbers run VGM/FY/000001 per financial year.
Sheets tabs needed: Orders (new columns), Invoices (see sheets/Invoices.csv).
